props.name: allowOverflow
props.description: Whether the panel should be strictly contained within the boundary when dragging

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the part.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether the panel should close when the escape key is pressed

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the panel when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the panel.

props.name: defaultPosition
props.description:
The initial position of the panel when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the position of the panel.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: The default size of the panel

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the panel is disabled

props.name: draggable
props.description: Whether the panel is draggable

props.name: finalFocusEl
props.description:
Element to receive focus when the panel is closed.
By default, the trigger element is focused.

props.name: getAnchorPosition
props.description:
Function that returns the initial position of the panel when it is opened.
If provided, will be used instead of the default position.

props.name: getBoundaryEl
props.description:
The boundary of the panel. Useful for recalculating the boundary rect when
the it is resized.

props.name: gridSize
props.description: The snap grid for the panel

props.name: hideMode
props.description:
How to hide content when mounted but not present.
- `'display-none'`: HTML `hidden` attribute. Effects stay alive.
- `'activity'`: React 19 `<Activity mode="hidden">`. Effects pause. Requires React 19+.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the floating panel. Useful for composition.

props.name: immediate
props.description: Whether to synchronize the present change immediately or defer it to the next frame

props.name: initialFocusEl
props.description:
Element to receive focus when the panel is opened.
By default, the first focusable element in the content is focused.

props.name: lazyMount
props.description: Whether to enable lazy mounting

props.name: lockAspectRatio
props.description: Whether the panel is locked to its aspect ratio

props.name: maxSize
props.description: The maximum size of the panel

props.name: minSize
props.description: The minimum size of the panel

props.name: onEnterComplete

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description: Function called when the animation ends in the closed state

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Function called when the panel is opened or closed

props.name: onPositionChange
props.description: Function called when the position of the panel changes via dragging

props.name: onPositionChangeEnd
props.description: Function called when the position of the panel changes via dragging ends

props.name: onSizeChange
props.description: Function called when the size of the panel changes via resizing

props.name: onSizeChangeEnd
props.description: Function called when the size of the panel changes via resizing ends

props.name: onStageChange
props.description: Function called when the stage of the panel changes

props.name: persistRect

props.name: present

props.name: resizable

props.name: restoreFocus

props.name: size
